subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Shared runtime object infrastructure reconstructed from validated function IR: a font-resource UI widget constructor plus its scalar deleting destructor and a conditional geometry-display update; a scrollable tile-grid with clamped scroll-offset and counter methods; a child-widget list container (vtable off_5AC760) with mouse hit-testing and vtable-notification teardown; a global linked-list manager using 12-byte {value,next,flag} nodes with prepend, detach-and-free-all, ring-buffer eviction and simple destruction; an OSC script-parser state initializer with default log paths; allocation helpers over the 0x53CBxx family; a string-normalizing hash-table lookup with compound-key extension; two distinct doubly-linked-list insert/append variants; object-registration helpers sharing a receiver back-reference field; a large float-backed state-struct default initializer; and rectangle-rendering and state-mode configuration helpers.

Scalar deleting destructor: unconditionally run real destructor 0x0048E670, then FreeWrapper_7bcf(this) when deleting-flag bit 0 of a2 is set, return this.
Trivial pair setter: store argument a2 at this+0x14 and a3 at this+0x18, return a2; used by UITileGrid (0x0048F870).

Increment scroll offset 0x168 by a2, or by default increment this+0x178 when a2 is negative; clamp to maximum this+0x16C, call UITileGrid (0x0048F870), return its result.

Widget-list destructor: install vtable off_5AC760 at 0x0, walk child list from head this+0xE0 via node next +4; for each node with flag byte node+0xC set and first dword non-zero dispatch sub-object vtable entry 0 with argument 1; free every node via FreeWrapper_7bcf; zero 0xE0..0xEC and chain to base destructor.

classes.name: FontResourceObject
classes.responsibility: UI widget/font resource with a string buffer. The constructor (0x0048E300) runs the base widget initializer ConstructorWithByteParams (0x00487220), zeroes fields 0xE4 and 0xFC, sets 0x100 to -1, installs the off_5AC490 vtable and resets the string buffer via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650). The scalar deleting destructor (0x0048E650) runs the real destructor 0x0048E670 unconditionally and frees storage via FreeWrapper_7bcf only when the deleting-flag bit 0 is set. Field semantics and the real destructor's own class identity are not established in this packet.

classes.responsibility: Conditional display/geometry update (0x0048E5C0): queries whether a video/geometry resource needs a reload through the virtual method at vtable+0xA0; when no reload is needed it reads a source rectangle at this+0xE8..0xF4, obtains the render surface via Accessor (0x00490920) and copies the region with RenderSurfaceFillCopy (0x004918D0). Whether the copy targets the display or another destination surface is not established.

classes.name: ScrollableTileGrid
classes.responsibility: Scrollable UI tile-grid container holding a scroll offset at this+0x168, a maximum bound at this+0x16C and a default increment at this+0x178. Both methods adjust the offset by a caller argument (or the stored default when the argument is negative) and clamp it, then recompute tile positions by calling UITileGrid (0x0048F870) and return its result.

classes.responsibility: Trivial two-field setter (0x0048EA20): stores integer arguments into this+0x14 and this+0x18 and returns the first argument unchanged. Caller UITileGrid (0x0048F870) suggests the pair is a position or size tuple for a tile record, but the semantic role is inferred only from the caller.

classes.name: RangeSliderObject
classes.responsibility: Widget-style object whose constructor (0x0048EAA0) runs the shared base initializer ShortComputation_5e30 (0x00485E30), zeroes a wide field block, installs the off_5A4550 vtable and sets range-like defaults (0x100=1, 0x104=4, 0x108=0.5f, 0x170=-1, 0x178=10, byte 0x17C=1). Existing analysis proposes a UI slider range with 10 steps; the semantics of the range fields and the class implied by the vtable are not statically confirmed. It shares the base initializer 0x00485E30 with WidgetListContainer (0x00490250), which may indicate a common base class but is not proven.

classes.name: InputRegionStateToggle
classes.responsibility: Input-region interaction widget (0x004900A0): reads a cursor/input position via DualFieldRead (0x00498880), computes bounding boundaries with sub_487060 (0x00487060) and sub_4870E0 (0x004870E0), and toggles the state flag at this+0xE0 (0->1, 1->0, 2 unchanged, other->1; miss sets 1). The new state is dispatched through the vtable+0x40 method and followed by the vtable+0x98 method. The coordinate space and the dispatched targets are unknown.

classes.name: WidgetListContainer
classes.responsibility: UI container managing a child-widget linked list. The initializer (0x00490250) runs the shared base initializer ShortComputation_5e30 (0x00485E30), zeroes 0xE0..0xF0 and installs the off_5AC760 vtable. The destructor (0x004902C0) reinstalls the same vtable, walks the list rooted at this+0xE0 (node next at +4, notify-flag byte at node+0xC), dispatches sub-object vtable entry 0 with argument 1 for flagged nodes, frees nodes via FreeWrapper_7bcf, zeroes 0xE0..0xEC and chains to a base destructor. The mouse handler (0x00490550) gates on state 3-5 from ShortComputation_6720, reads input via DualFieldRead, hit-tests at vtable+0x30, dispatches vtable+0x40 with 0/4 and walks the child list (count at 0xEC) with RectangleBoundsCheck, then runs VTableDispatchListIteration (0x00490660).

classes.responsibility: Generic embedded linked-list manager with 12-byte nodes {+0 value, +4 next, +8 ownership/state flag}. 0x00490AA0 allocates the node via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (0x00587C03), zeroes the payload via ShortArrayZeroInit (0x00491330) and prepends to the manager object obtained from GlobalDataRead (0x00490930), tracking head v2[4], tail/head aliases v2[5]/v2[6] and count v2[7]. 0x004910D0 detaches and frees every node of a 4-dword sentinel (reparenting values via 0x00490AA0, invoking EmptyStub_0170 (0x004B0170) on flagged values, freeing via FreeWrapper_7bcf). 0x004917C0 advances a circular ring buffer and evicts aged nodes (node+8 used as age counter, max 3) into an external list. 0x00491DB0 frees a simple {value,next,flag} list and its data. The node+8 byte serves both as ownership flag and age counter, which is a contradiction to reconcile.

First unlinks the incoming node a2 via DoublyLinkedListNodeUnlink (0x00495A20) and zeroes its link slots, then walks the list from head this+0x14 following each node's next pointer at +0x64, and splices a2 at the tail this+0x18 (a2 prev at +0x68).
